## Review checklist
- [ ] Links resolve.
- [ ] Page inventory matches tracked HTML.
- [ ] Navigation diagram matches relative links.
- [ ] Source claims are evidence-based.
- [ ] Existing screenshots are distinguished from new captures.
- [ ] No coursework source changed unintentionally.
- [ ] No false accessibility/test claims.
